description: T-2612: workbook names on a deleted sheet. Sheet S holds C4:C7 = 1,2,4,8; names nm = S!$C$4 and rng = S!$C$4:$C$7; sheet F holds A1 =nm, A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(rng), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =ISREF(nm). Ops: delete_sheet S, then add a new blank S. A revived name reads the new blank S (A1 0, A3 0, A5 TRUE); a lost one is #REF!.
